analysts.label: Technical analyst
analysts.argument: Price below EMA20/SMA20, MACD histogram negative, and composite SELL signal indicate bearish momentum; RSI and Bollinger Bands neutral, volume normal. Downtrend persists despite headlines.

analysts.label: Fundamentals & news analyst
analysts.argument: Technicals show bearish signals (MACD, EMA/SMA) but headlines reflect mixed sentiment—some bullish on Musk's ventures, others bearish on valuation and cash flow. No clear fundamental shift; price action near neutral indicators (RSI, Bollinger).

analysts.label: Macro analyst
analysts.argument: Tesla shows bearish technicals (MACD, EMA/SMA) but headlines highlight growth narratives. Macro shows elevated yields (10Y 4.75%, 2Y 4.28%) and low unemployment (4.2%), suggesting tighter policy. No clear directional edge; mixed signals warrant neutrality.

researchers.label: Bull researcher
researchers.argument: Despite bearish technicals like MACD negative and price below EMA/SMA, headlines highlight transformative growth narratives—robotaxi, AI, and energy ventures—that could re-rate Tesla beyond auto valuation. Macro yields are elevated but Tesla's innovation edge may outpace tightening, offering asymmetric upside if execution succeeds, justifying cautious bullish stance with low confidence.

researchers.label: Bear researcher
researchers.argument: Technicals are decisively bearish: price below EMA20/SMA20, MACD histogram negative, and composite SELL signal confirm downtrend momentum. Despite bullish headlines on Musk's ventures, RSI and Bollinger Bands remain neutral, volume is normal, and elevated Treasury yields (4.75% 10Y) increase discount rate pressure on growth stocks like TSLA. Fundamentals show no improvement in cash flow or valuation justification, making the current uptrend unsustainable.

trader.rationale: Technicals show clear bearish structure: price below EMA20/SMA20, negative MACD histogram, and composite SELL signal. Despite bullish headlines, RSI and Bollinger Bands are neutral, volume is normal, and elevated 10Y yield (4.75%) increases discount rate pressure on growth stocks. Downtrend momentum is intact.

risk.verdict: Bear case stronger: technicals show clear downtrend, macro headwinds from high yields, and no fundamental improvement. Sell justified despite narrative noise.
concerns: Elevated discount rate pressure from 4.75% 10Y yield
